positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Worked on the Cloud Development team to implement a file comparison application.
Developed a wrapper API to streamline and enhance the functionality of the Bitbucket GET API.
Orchestrated the creation of a MongoDB database collection for database management and implemented CRUD APIs calls to
interact with the collection utilizing Spring Boot framework.
Contributed to the development of the front‑end system, which performs a comparison of database files to check for differences,
and communicates with backend services.
Worked with Node.js to create an Express server, hosting the webpage locally for efficient development and testing
